title: Johnny Cash's Condo
description:
Welcome to the Johnny Cash Hideaway, a one-of-a-kind, country music-themed retreat in the heart of Nashville!  Step into this cozy, stylishly decorated condo inspired by the Man In Black himself, and immerse yourself in the history and culture of country music!  Johnny Cash memorabilia from bubble heads, to vintage posters, to having a cup of coffee from a Sun Records mug these pieces celebrate the life and legacy of Johnny Cash. The condo comes with a fully stocked kitchen and washer and dryer!

The space
The condo sleeps four with a queen bed in the bedroom and a pull out mattress from the couch in the living room.  It has a fully equipped kitchen and washer & dryer for extended stays. It is an easy ten minute Uber or Lyft to downtown Nashville nestled in between downtown and the airport.  It also has free parking and WIFI on the premises.  There is also a dog park area as well as charcoal grills and picnic tables in the courtyard.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire condo.
